sources.entry: CMS Made Simple - Faster and easier management of website contents, scalable for small businesses to large corporations. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.name: CMS Made Simple
summary.one_liner: CMS Made Simple is an open source, GPL-2.0 licensed content management system written in PHP that uses the Smarty templating engine.
use_cases: Maintain and update a website's content
Build a site from custom HTML and CSS designs
Extend a website with third party modules
Build feature-rich web applications on a CMS
Run a small business or corporate website
summary.what_it_does:
CMS Made Simple provides an editing interface for end users and a backend with an extensive API for developers. Designers can turn HTML and CSS designs into CMS Made Simple templates, which use the Smarty templating engine. Developers can create custom modules and tags, and a range of third party modules and tags is available to add features. The project encourages community contributions and forks. The page lists recent core and module releases, including CMS Made Simple Core 2.2.24 (September 2026).</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">open source
notable: Smarty templating engine with HTML/CSS template design, no PHP needed for templates
Extensible API with custom modules and tags
GPL-2.0 licensed and open to contributions
caveats: Page does not state pricing for add-on modules beyond describing them as third party
Forum posts reference a reported HTTP 500 error on the Tags page after upgrading to 2.2.24
